faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the PIHMCT Assistant Lecturer recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to receive the application for the PIHMCT Assistant Lecturer recruitment is 25th October 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address by this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Assistant Lecturer post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies announced for the Assistant Lecturer position at the Pondicherry Institute of Hotel Management and Catering Technology.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Assistant Lecturer role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Post Graduate degree in Hospitality/Tourism or an MBA, or a Full-Time Degree/Diploma in Hotel Administration/Hospitality Management/Culinary Arts with at least 55% marks. NHTET qualification is also required, unless the candidate holds a PhD.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Assistant Lecturer post is 35 years as of 1st July 2026. Age relaxation will be provided as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Lecturer position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Assistant Lecturer post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 35,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Assistant Lecturer post?
faq.answer: The selection process will primarily involve a Skill Test as prescribed by NCHMCT, with weightage given to NHTET scores.

faq.question: Q8. In which mode should the application be submitted?
faq.answer: Applications for the PIHMCT Assistant Lecturer recruitment must be submitted in offline mode, by post, to the address specified in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of the Pondicherry Institute of Hotel Management and Catering Technology, which is http://pihmct.py.gov.in.

faq.question: Q10. What documents are required to be submitted with the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates need to attach self-attested copies of required documents, including photograph, signature, ID proof, and relevant educational and experience certificates, along with the filled application form.
